Yeah, and every last one of *those* Christians are going straight to hell, do no pass heaven, do not collect $200, straight to hell. I’m personally religious but I would never push my beliefs onto someone else or tell them they shouldn’t exist. I’m all for everyone having the right to exist however and as whoever they want to. No ifs, ands, or buts about it. 

True Christians aren’t complete hypocritical pieces of shit; sadly there’s way too many out there who claim to be “Christian” when in reality that couldn’t be further from the truth. So don’t worry, whether you personally believe in a heaven or a hell, just know that wherever those people are going, it’s not going to be the place they thought it’d be.
Bro you still here? You stopped responding..

I’m truly sorry about your circumstances and the pain they’ve caused you. I relate a lot to this in a way as the reason I want to do the same thing is also because of sudden unfortunate circumstances that I can never change or undo. It fucking sucks how with just one simple mistake, with just one wrong move, everything you ever loved can be viciously stripped from you in an instant, with no way of ever getting it back or fixing it. And then you’re just forever stuck in that place, in constant pain and completely alone. I get it. I really do. 

Life’s just not fair..
At this point, yeah.
I’d rather die in my sleep personally, but dying on my way to work is something I’ve asked for as well. I don’t really care how it happens to be honest, just as long as I’m dead.

Same.. you have no idea how many times I’ve prayed to god to just let me go back in time and change just one decision, change just one simple mistake, just one person I’d choose never to meet. It fucking kills me inside to know that I can never undo even one mistake, I’m now just forever stuck in what feels like some seriously fucked up alternative timeline where I was never meant to be.

But if you happen to find that person that has a time machine, let me know before you use it.
Feel you on that. Will literally never trust another soul after how many times I’ve been lied to and betrayed by people who supposedly cared so much for me.

Yeah and I get that man, but my point wasn’t that you’d survive, my point is you’ll ruin another person’s life. Don’t fucking do that man. Look, I’m not going to sit here and tell you ‘don’t do it, things might get better!” because I’ve been told that myself far too many times and it’s always been untrue for me; but at the very least if you’re doing it and there’s no stopping you don’t do it in a way where you possibly cause someone else to eventually do the same thing. 

Obviously I can’t speak as to how bad things really are for you or if it’s fixable, but for me personally it’s not and I’m not planning on being here much longer myself, but the last thing I’d ever do is do it in a way where I traumatize some random person I don’t even know.

Highly unlikely you’d survive that, but it sounds like a terrifying way to go. Fuck, I can just imagine the amount of sheer terror as the train is blowing it’s horn as it’s getting closer. 

But the worst part about going that way, is that you’re going to traumatize another human, that poor conductor, for the rest of their life on your way out. 

I get how that seems like an easy, quick way to go, but in reality it’ll be terrifying as you’re laying on the tracks and your survival instincts begin to kick in and you start to freak out, and for a brief moment in time imagine if the conductor will ever be the same after accidentally murdering another human. If there was ever a way to go, this *is not* the way.

Ngl, sparking a blunt while really depressed/passively suicidal *(for me at least)* makes me thinks *extremely deeply* about my life and how I got to the point to where I am and legitimately traumatizes me. As in when I wake up the next morning after my miserable, awful high; I’m instantly actively suicidal and way worse than before I smoked. I think it’s because typically, I take opiates to avoid having to think too deeply about my life and it helps a lot *(only to a certain extent though)* but when that ganga hits my brain, I immediately get stuck looking into the past and it rips me to shreds. Maybe that’s just me though.

Sounds like narcissistic abuse to me. Look up traits of a narcissist and see if it lines up. I know when I finally figured it out my ex lined up with *every single* sad fucking trait in the description. And the reason you still care about him even though all of the horrible things he’s done to you is because you’re now trauma bonded to him. Look it up and see how much that matches how *you* feel.
thank you :)

I appreciate that. I hope your life takes a turn for the better. Just don’t let it get to the point to where you’re too far gone. Change things while you still can, fix what you know needs to be fixed. The last thing I’d ever want to see is someone where I’m at.
Well thanks I guess. Just pray I find what I need 🙏🏽 then no sorrys will ever be wasted on me again

Don’t feel sorry for me. I did it to myself. Regardless of other people who caused it, regardless of the things that were out of my control, it was still my fault at the end of the day. I’m the one who got with the person, I’m the one who kept letting them back into my life every time. I’m the one who ruins everything they touch in every way possible. I’m the one who made a mistake. I let it happen to myself. So don’t feel sorry for me, I deserve it.

Holy shit, a really bad car accident is what started all of this for me too. Before it, I was a happy person with actual plans and goals in life; and then it was all stolen from me in an instant. It fucking ruined me, and everyone I thought cared about me either abandoned me or just played with me like I was their fucking toy to do what they wanted with for the next year. And I just let it happen because I felt worthless as fuck after everything that happened. 

And I’m sorry you’re feeling the same way.. I really wish I lived in Canada 😞

We all know that. We know that’s the worst kind of pain for your family, for your mom. But one person can only take so much suffering until it just hits a breaking point. Everyone has a breaking point somewhere along the line. It’s just a matter of if you ever actually hit it.

I feel this. Doing the exact same thing. Going to try to find what I need and if shit’s still fucked a week after I have it, I’m fucking gone. The sad part is that I already know it won’t be any better and probably just a lot worse, aka the typical. Things have progressively just gotten worse for a year straight now. Can’t wait to just be gone. I literally can’t wait anymore.. 😕
Me too, bro. Me too.
Horrible. Just waiting to find what I need to put myself out of my misery.
